units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I often feel quite uneasy.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I often feel quite uneasy.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I often feel quite uneasy.

units.rawText: After Turing... After that incident, I've forced myself to get it together and devoted myself to the work of running the Sector.
units.displayText: After Turing... After that incident, I've forced myself to get it together and devoted myself to the work of running the Sector.

spans.text: After Turing... After that incident, I've forced myself to get it together and devoted myself to the work of running the Sector.

units.rawText: I kept telling myself that I need to safeguard everything that Turing sacrificed herself to protect.
units.displayText: I kept telling myself that I need to safeguard everything that Turing sacrificed herself to protect.

spans.text: I kept telling myself that I need to safeguard everything that Turing sacrificed herself to protect.

units.rawText: But what can I do? All the other agents are actually senior to me, and there are many things and procedures which I don't understand. Everyone's counting on me, but who can I count on?

units.rawText: So you're saying I can count on everyone too? That's... quite an unexpected answer.

spans.text: So you're saying I can count on everyone too? That's... quite an unexpected answer.

units.rawText: Indeed, it should have occurred to me after seeing the way the Exiles live. Well done, Professor.
